title: Kaplansky decomposition of direct summands of sums of countably generated modules over arbitrary rings
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: The author constructs a transfinite filtration compatible with two projections, using countable matrix closure along successive anti-diagonals to ensure every successor stage is a sum of original summands.
